meta.name: baoyu-xhs-images
meta.description: Generates infographic image card series with 12 visual styles, 8 layouts, and 3 color palettes. Breaks content into 1-10 cartoon-style image cards optimized for social media engagement. Use when user mentions "小红书图片", "小红书种草", "小绿书", "微信图文", "微信贴图", "image cards", "图片卡片", baoyu-xhs-images, or wants social media infographic series.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将内容转为多张卡通风格社交媒体信息图卡片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速制作吸引眼球的社交媒体信息图系列。
copy.tagline_en: Turn content into cartoon-style social media infographic card series.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create eye-catching social media infographic series.

howto.what: 当用户提出“小红书图片”“小绿书”“微信图文”等图片卡片需求时,Claude 会把内容拆成 1-10 张卡通风格的信息图卡片,从 12 种视觉风格、8 种布局、3 种配色中自动挑选或让用户指定组合,然后生成图片。
howto.when: 当你在对话中提到“小红书图片”“小绿书”“微信图文”等关键词,或想把内容做成社交媒体信息图系列时,该技能会接管这类请求并开始处理。

say.text: 把这篇长文做成小红书图片卡片,总共 4 张
say.note: Claude 会先确认卡片数量与样式,再生成图片

say.text: 用暖色风格和对比布局,做一套小红书种草图
say.note: Claude 会按这套风格与布局来设计卡片

say.text: 跳过确认,直接生成 3 张小绿书卡片
say.note: 这一步省略提问确认,按推荐方案直接出图

howto.what_en: When asked for Xiaohongshu/WeChat image cards, Claude breaks content into 1–10 cartoon-style image cards, auto-picks or offers 12 styles, 8 layouts, 3 palettes, then renders images.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions Xiaohongshu image, Xiao Lv Shu, WeChat image-text, or similar listed keywords, or wants a social-media infographic card series.

say_en.text: Turn this long article into Xiaohongshu image cards, 4 total.
say_en.note: Claude confirms count and style first, then generates.

say_en.text: Make a Xiaohongshu recommendation set, warm style, with a comparison layout.
say_en.note: Claude designs the cards with that style and layout.

say_en.text: Skip confirmation and directly generate 3 Xiao Lv Shu cards.
say_en.note: This skips questions and auto-outputs using the recommended plan.
